newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE names Obaid bin Saif al-Nasseri oil minister.
newsitem.headline: UAE names Obaid bin Saif al-Nasseri oil minister.

text.p: United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan on Tuesday named Obaid bin Saif al-Nasseri as oil minister, the official WAM news agency reported.
The new oil minister replaced Rakad bin Salem bin Rakad, public works and housing minister who held the title acting oil minister.
Nasseri is from a prominent Abu Dhabi family. He has held a number of senior posts in the financial sector, notably at the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and the National Bank of Abu Dhabi.
